bios.short_bio: Nola Fern is an independent producer making slow electronic pieces from found sounds.
bios.long_bio: Nola Fern is an independent producer making slow electronic pieces from found sounds, with field recordings among their influences.
bios.track_description: “Soft Current” is an ambient / downtempo track described as spacious, meditative, and gentle. It is scheduled for release on November 23, 2026.

pitches.subject: Submission: Nola Fern — “Soft Current”
pitches.body:
Hello Soft Focus Sounds,

I’d love to submit “Soft Current,” an ambient / downtempo piece with a spacious, meditative, gentle feel, made from found sounds.

Listen: https://example.com/nola

Thank you,
Nola Fern
